messages:
Elena M.: Quick heads-up: new billing policy goes live June 15. Main changes: tiered soft rate limits, 7-day overage forgiveness for hosted metered plans, and trial credits now expire after 90 days. Full doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/june15 :loudspeaker:
RevOps Bot: Published the rollout doc + CSV invoice schema: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/june15/csv-schema
Ben S.: Will we surface rate-limit headers in responses? SDKs need them for smarter retries.
Elena M.: Yes — adding `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset`. Eng teams, please add to client libs.
Olivia P.: For Dedicated customers: no change to committed billing, correct?
Elena M.: Correct. Dedicated/reserved plans unaffected; overage forgiveness only applies to hosted metered customers.
Support Bot: Action: update KB and canned responses about credit expiry and overage disputes.
Ben S.: Any change to invoice layout? We need a stable CSV header for exports.
Elena M.: Yes — consolidated monthly CSV will include `invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,total_amount,token_count,overage_amount,credits_applied`. Sample included in the doc.
Olivia P.: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb to use in support replies?
Elena M.: Draft in #marketing-drafts: "We're updating our billing controls to reduce surprise rejections during transient spikes and simplify exports. No immediate charges during the 7-day grace window. See the FAQ for examples."
RevOps Bot: Reminder: rollout date June 15. AMA scheduled June 8 10:00 PT in #all-hands.
